title: scale-colour-viridis-c
subtitle: Continuous viridis colour scale.
category: Scales
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


`option` selects between `"viridis"`, `"magma"`, `"plasma"`, `"inferno"`,
and `"cividis"`.

## Usage

```typst
scale-colour-viridis-c(
  option: "viridis",
  name: none,
  limits: none,
  breaks: auto,
  labels: auto,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `option` | `"viridis"` | Palette name: `"viridis"`, `"magma"`, `"plasma"`, `"inferno"`, or `"cividis"`. |
| `name` | `none` | Legend title. Overrides any name set via [`labs`](../labs/labs.qmd) when both are present. |
| `limits` | `none` | Pair `(lo, hi)` clipping the trained domain, or `none`. |
| `breaks` | `auto` | Array of break values for the legend, or `auto`. |
| `labels` | `auto` | Array of legend labels aligned with `breaks`, or `auto`. |

## Returns

Scale object consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/scale-colour-viridis-c-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 12).map(i => (x: i, y: i, z: i * 0.5))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y", colour: "z"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 3pt),),
  scales: (scale-colour-viridis-c(option: "magma"),),
)
```
